args.description: Overrides the default args for the Keycloak container

command.description: Overrides the default entrypoint of the Keycloak container

enableServiceLinks.description: Indicates whether information about services should be injected into Pod's environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links

extraContainers.description: Additional sidecar containers, e. g. for a database proxy, such as Google's cloudsql-proxy

extraEnv.description:
Additional environment variables for Keycloak
- name: KC_LOG_LEVEL
value: DEBUG

extraEnvFrom.description: Additional environment variables for Keycloak mapped from Secret or ConfigMap

extraInitContainers.description: Additional init containers, e. g. for providing custom themes

extraManifests.description:
Extra Kubernetes objects to deploy with the helm chart
- |
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
name: {{ include "keycloak.fullname" . }}-tpl
data:
foo: bar
-   apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
name: "{{ include \"keycloak.fullname\" . }}-tpl"
data:
foo: bar

extraPorts.description: Add additional ports, e. g. for admin console or exposing JGroups ports

extraVolumeMounts.description: Add additional volumes mounts, e. g. for custom themes

extraVolumes.description: Add additional volumes, e. g. for custom themes

fullnameOverride.description: Optionally override the fully qualified name

hostAliases.description:
Mapping between IPs and hostnames that will be injected as entries in the Pod's hosts files
- ip: "1.2.3.4"
hostnames:
- "my.host.com"

httpRoute.description:
Expose the service via gateway-api HTTPRoute
Requires Gateway API resources and suitable controller installed within the cluster
(see: https://gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io/guides/)

tag.description: Overrides the Keycloak image tag whose default is the chart appVersion

imagePullSecrets.description:
Image pull secrets for the Pod
- name: myRegistrKeySecretName

lifecycleHooks.description:
Lifecycle hooks for the Keycloak container
postStart:
exec:
command:
- /bin/sh
- -c
- ls

namespaceOverride.description:
Optionally override the namespace for all resources. Useful for umbrella charts that
deploy multiple aliased keycloak instances each into their own namespace.

podManagementPolicy.description: Pod management policy. One of `Parallel` or `OrderedReady`

podSecurityContext.description: SecurityContext for the entire Pod. Every container running in the Pod will inherit this SecurityContext. This might be relevant when other components of the environment inject additional containers into running Pods (service meshes are the most prominent example for this)

replicas.description: The number of replicas to create (has no effect if autoscaling enabled)

resources.description:
Pod resource requests and limits
requests:
cpu: "500m"
memory: "1024Mi"
limits:
cpu: "500m"
memory: "1024Mi"

restartPolicy.description: Pod restart policy. One of `Always`, `OnFailure`, or `Never`

revisionHistoryLimit.description: StatefulSet's revision history limit (number of old ReplicaSets to retain). Defaults to 10 if not set

skipInitContainers.description:
When using service meshes which rely on a sidecar, it may be necessary to skip init containers altogether,
since the sidecar doesn't start until the init containers are done, and the sidecar may be required
for network access.
For example, Istio in strict mTLS mode prevents the dbchecker init container from ever completing

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Termination grace period in seconds for Keycloak shutdown. Clusters with a large cache might need to extend this to give Infinispan more time to rebalance

volumeClaimTemplates.description:
Add volume claim templates to the StatefulSet, e. g. for dynamic provisioning
- metadata:
name: themes
spec:
accessModes: [ "ReadWriteOncePod" ]
storageClassName: "my-storage-class"
resources:
requests:
storage: 1Gi
